cohort: 186 sets of twin pregnancies delivered at two hospitals in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa over a one year period
finding: Of the 80 HIV infected mothers, there was a 0.9% HIV transmission rate to one twin, with no transmission via vaginal delivery but a 1.4% transmission rate for the first-born twin following Caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: There was no transmission for twin 1 or twin 2 via vaginal delivery, but a 1.4% transmission for twin 1 and 0% for twin 2 following Caesarean delivery.
